ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Visible surface areas exhibit a high ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels, approximately 85:15.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: one contiguous high-intensity white longitudinal band along the leading edge. Right lobe: primary low-intensity dark field with micro-clusters of high-contrast white/orange pixels localized on the distal trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular, non-linear boundary with high-amplitude jagged peaks (10-20 pixels) concentrated at the distal lobe tips, distinct from the smooth water-line interface.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe exhibits a linear, steep diagonal trajectory from the water interface to the tip; the right lobe exhibits a more rounded, convex outer curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast pixel groupings in white, tan, and orange tones, localized at the distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, vertically-oriented low-intensity linear disruptions visible on the central surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular structural accretion and jagged edge degradation localized at the lobe terminals due to dense colonization of macro-structures.
